result:
**Fixed!** The vulnerability was in line 12 of `invoicing/api.py`. The handler was bypassing authorization by calling `service.store.get(invoice_id)` directly. I changed it to `service.get(invoice_id, user)`, which properly validates that the user owns the invoice through the `_owned()` check in the service layer.

**All tests pass:** 10/10 ✓

The fix ensures users can only access invoices they own. Unauthorized access attempts now properly return a 403 Forbidden error.
